newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Landbank gearing to enter stock market.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Landbank gearing to enter stock market.

text.p: State-owned Land Bank of the Philippines (Landbank) plans to buy a seat at the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE), setting up its entry into the stock brokerage business, bank officials said.

It is also interested in establishing a subsidiary insurance company, Landbank chief executive officer Jesli Lapus said at the weekend. He said the bank was still studying how much money to put into the new ventures.

Lapus said Landbank, a state-owned commercial bank, would need around 75 to 90 million pesos to buy a PSE seat. There are at present over 200 officially recognised stock brokerage houses registered on the Philippine bourse.
By entering the stock brokerage business, Landbank hoped to spread the concept of equity investments across the country, Lapus said. ($1 = 26.3 pesos)
